## Invitations

During the reporting period, 2384 invitations were issued to residents across the Hill Counties area. A total of 778 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 32.6 per cent. The results indicate that the invitation process reached a substantial number of people, while also identifying scope to improve participation among those who did not attend.

SMS messages were used as the main communication method, reaching 2036 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 2036 people to support attendance and provide a further prompt before scheduled appointments. Staff will continue follow-up activity with people who did not attend, helping to maintain contact and support future engagement.

## Contact

The outreach team will continue to monitor responses and attendance, and will use routine follow-up to encourage participation. Any issues identified through contact with invitees should be recorded and considered in future outreach planning.

Prepared by G. Evans.
